title: How to Cancel LastPass — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel LastPass Premium subscription. Export your passwords and switch to a free alternative. Step-by-step instructions.
intro: LastPass's free tier is now very limited (one device type only). If you're leaving, export your passwords first, then cancel through billing settings.

steps.title: Export your passwords
steps.text: In the LastPass vault: More Options → Advanced → Export. Download as .csv file. Store this securely — it contains all your credentials in plain text.
steps.tip: Delete the exported .csv file after importing into your new password manager. It's a security risk if left on your device.

steps.title: Go to LastPass billing settings
steps.text: Visit lastpass.com/billing_update.php while signed in. Or: Account Settings → Subscription → Manage.

steps.title: Click "Cancel" or "Downgrade to Free"
steps.text: Find the cancellation option and click it. LastPass will explain the free tier limitations (one device type: desktop OR mobile, not both).

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Confirm your choice. Premium features remain until your billing period ends. Then you're on the free tier (single device type, no priority support).
steps.tip: LastPass Free only works on ONE device type (computer OR phone). If you use both, you need a paid plan or a different service.

warnings: LastPass Free limits you to one device type (desktop OR mobile — not both). This makes it nearly unusable for most people.
Export your vault BEFORE canceling to ensure you have all your passwords.
Given LastPass's security breaches in 2022-2023, consider migrating to a different service entirely (Bitwarden, 1Password).
If subscribed through Apple/Google, cancel through their platforms.

faqs.a: Barely. LastPass Free only works on one device type (computers OR phones, not both). For most people, this makes it impractical. Consider Bitwarden instead.
Given the 2022-2023 security breaches that exposed encrypted vault data, many security experts recommend migrating away from LastPass entirely to Bitwarden or 1Password.

faqs.q: How do I switch from LastPass to Bitwarden?
faqs.a: Export from LastPass as .csv → go to Bitwarden web vault → Tools → Import Data → select LastPass (csv) format → upload. Takes 5 minutes.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from LastPass?
faqs.a: LastPass offers refunds within 30 days of purchase. Contact support for requests. After 30 days, refunds are unlikely.

refund.details: LastPass offers refunds within 30 days of purchase. Contact their support team for refund requests.

retentionTactics: LastPass may offer a discounted rate or remind you of the free tier's limitations.
They may suggest the Families plan as a cheaper per-person option.
